title: Minestruct: Recrafted
description: Enhance your building skills and diversify your caves!
body:
Welcome to Minestruct Recrafted!

This is a Forge remake/port of the MCreator Minestruct mod from 1.18.2 by yomaipar. This version has several changes and enhanced changes. 

-Over 500 brand new building blocks. Explore from all finds of designs. from Fabric blocks, pillars, to the more absurd, like the bread block and... pumpkin bricks?

-Find all the snails! This mod introduces nine different snails exclusive to certain biome types. Find them all to craft the ultimate snail!

-Nine new stone types generating - Find nine new stone types generating across your world, and craft blocks with them!

The possibilities are endless with this mod. Build structures you never knew you could make with this incredible mod!'




**Credits go to yomaipar, who originally created this awesome mod and all of its' assets. I only made a handful of the assets in this mod alongside the code. **

if you're an original author and wish for the mod to be taken down, dm me on discord at phwee and I'll take care of your request.
